full_page.content:
1936, December
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 155 Cont.
Dec. 8 The remarkable Gregory - convert.
Mrs. Anna Devereau - 80 - Mother of big family ..... like possessed
Page 156
Dec. 9th Louis Punkes - 68 - and son for return to Church. Father not to confession since marriage 46 yrs.
11th Thelma Ashbury - 10 - in Mt. Clemens Sanit ... Infantile paralysis now a year. Parents non Cath. Friends have been in the monastery and have asked for prayers a number of times. The child has improved quite decidedly - can now walk on crutches.
12 Mrs. M. Hock - 50 - in Eloise - mental (change) - husb .. away from Conf. 3 yrs. Enrolls To-day and goes to confession.
Maude Moreau .... widow .... 40 -
Eva Habib - 29 - Keeping undesirable Company
Anthony Byzewski - 27 - epileptic now 6 yrs. - Prayed for 5 weeks ago- wonderfully improved but still gets weak spells about twice a week ...
Mrs. Anna Eagling - 57 - Baptist - in Eloise now 8 yrs. Enrolled To-day by daughter - Mental.
Albert Kempe - 41 - visiting beer gardens and neglecting wife & 5 children. ..
Page 157 Dec. 21 Rose Rock - 33 - trying to get work (in Brigg's) to support invalid husband and brother ...
21 Neil Weber - 24 - auto accident and diabetic - unconscious since 19th Enrolled at 4 :10P.M ..
John Runyon - 46 - thrown 15 feet to ground Dec. 5th by explosion of compressed air-valve. Wife phoned next day for Enrollment - is com- ing along astonishingly .....
Iva Belle Foot - 38 - methodist - siatic rhumatic Mrs. Cath. Wick ...
